_about: Lakes lowered on purpose, with their level gauge (GKD Bayern) and marks in m above sea level, see backend/rowfrog/lake_level.py. Forggensee marks from the gauge's 2025/26 season: full 780.3-780.7 m June to mid-November, lowered from mid-November (below 779.8 m on 15 Nov 2025), lowest 774.1 m in February, below 777.5 m from early December to mid-April, full again end of May. The drained mark is an estimate of when the club's landing stage runs dry; to be confirmed by the club.
